classes.name: MatcherFinder
classes.description: A class responsible for managing matcher processors, adding event listeners, and selecting processors based on match criteria.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MatcherFinder with a dependency injection container.

methods.name: addProcessor
methods.description: Adds a processor class to the list after validation and registers its event listeners.

methods.name: addListenerToDispatcher
methods.description: Adds a listener to a specified dispatcher within the container, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: getProcessor
methods.description: Returns an appropriate processor for a given matcher object, or null if none match.
